summary: Hero section whose headline sits in a dot grid and is revealed behind a bright front; the pointer pushes dots aside and a click sends a shockwave.

attributes.name: headline
attributes.description: Headline text, shown in an `<h2>` over the dot grid. Observed.

attributes.name: primary
attributes.description: Label of the primary button. Observed.

attributes.name: secondary
attributes.description: Label of the secondary button. Observed.

events.name: primary
events.description: Fires when the primary button is clicked.

events.name: secondary
events.description: Fires when the secondary button is clicked.

accessibility: The headline is a visible `<h2>` set in the sans font; the dot canvas behind it is `aria-hidden`. The heading level is fixed.
The secondary action is a native button; the primary action is a native button inside a nested `<hf-button>`.
motion: With reduced motion the headline and grid appear at once without the reveal or shimmer, clicks send no shockwave and the canvas redraws only on pointer movement.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.description: Pill text above the headline. Falls back to `New · Pixel HD`.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Subheading under the headline. Falls back to a sample sentence.

notes: The primary button is a nested `<hf-button>`, which `hf-hero` imports itself.
The headline scales with the element's width (28px to 60px) and wraps onto more lines when it does not fit; the dot grid clears around it.
